locators.content: Exact supplied paragraph: October2000 GVM, SKTelecom commercialisation, first/market-leader vendor claims, GNEX lineage, full backward compatibility and about50000 GVM contents.
SWAP June2000; GVM1X proposal August2000; SKTelecom GVM October2000; GVM2X August2001; Obox/GVM2.5X June2002; GNEX June2003.
Repeated claim of backward compatibility from GVM1X through GNEX and unchanged execution of earlier GVM contents.

limits: First-in-world and market-number-one are dated Sinjisoft marketing claims, not independently verified research conclusions.
About50000 GVM contents is neither50000 unique games nor a recovered corpus or Reunion compatibility count.
Full backward compatibility was a Sinjisoft product claim; this specific Kingston-derived implementation still has named legacy/OEM/network gaps.
No old network/PTP service, vendor executable or additional unknown firmware was launched in this bounded source-verification pass.
